plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my private value. Since my value is $24, I want to maximize potential profit. A good approach is to bid around 80% of my value, which would be $19.2. This strategy balances winning probability with minimizing overpayment. Other rational bidders will likely use similar logic.

In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below one's private value. Since my value is $16, I want to maximize potential profit. A good approach is to bid around $15.80 - just below my value. This allows me to potentially win if other bidders bid lower, while protecting against overpaying. With rational bidders, everyone understands the goal is to bid strategically near their private value.

In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Since my private value is $24, I want to maximize potential profit. A rational approach is to bid around $23.8 - this allows me to potentially win if other bidders bid lower, while protecting against overpaying relative to my true valuation. The goal is capturing positive consumer surplus.
